name: Emmet
description: Type abbreviations like div.card>h2+p and press Tab to expand full HTML/CSS instantly.
activationCode: (function startEmmet() { function checkAndInit() { var emmet = window.emmetMonaco || (window.emmetMonacoEs && window.emmetMonacoEs.default) || window.emmet; var monacoObj = window.monaco || (window.editor && window.editor.monaco); if (emmet && monacoObj) { try { if (typeof emmet.emmetHTML === 'function') { emmet.emmetHTML(monacoObj); emmet.emmetCSS(monacoObj); } else if (typeof emmet === 'function') { emmet(monacoObj); } } catch(err) { console.error('[Emmet Init Error]', err); } } else { setTimeout(checkAndInit, 300); } } checkAndInit(); })();
